mergedParams.userDescription: Fractal, kaleidoscopic text patterns morphing constantly with the music. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Fractal Kaleidoscope Text Morphing with Musical Typokinetics

prompts.prompt: Create a fractal kaleidoscopic typography preset where text continuously splits and mirrors itself in response to audio beats, forming symmetric patterns that expand and contract. Think of it like a video editor applying multiple mirror effects on text layers, then animating them with beat-synchronized keyframes. The text should start as normal caption/title text, then fragment into multiple mirrored copies that rotate around a central point, creating mandala-like patterns. Each word should have its own fractal behavior - splitting into 4, 8, or 16 copies based on audio intensity. Use caption data with word-level timing to ensure each word transforms at the right moment. Apply color shifts through hue rotation that cycles with the music tempo. The kaleidoscope effect should pulse with bass frequencies, expanding the pattern radius on beats and contracting between them.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' as containerProps.className. Create sub-presets for individual word fractal patterns. Each word uses a BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center' containing multiple TextAtom instances positioned absolutely with transforms. Use repeatChildrenProps to generate 8-16 text copies per word with incrementing rotation values (rotate-[45deg], rotate-[90deg], etc). Apply generic keyframe effects for continuous rotation (0 to 360deg) and scale pulsing. Use waveform effects in 'beat-zoom' mode targeting bass frequencies with sensitivity 0.8. For the kaleidoscope mirror effect, use CSS transforms: 'transform-origin-center scale-x-[-1]' for horizontal flips, combined with rotateZ for radial patterns. Implement hue-rotate filter animations synchronized to audio tempo. Set fitDurationTo: 'media' to match audio duration. Use internal effect presets for the base rotation, then layer waveform effects for beat reactivity. Performance: use will-change-transform on all animated elements, GPU-accelerated transforms only, no layout-triggering properties.

prompts.prompt: Design a liquid morphing typography system where text flows and reshapes like mercury responding to sound waves. Visualize this as a video editor using displacement maps and liquify effects on text layers, with the distortion intensity driven by audio waveforms. Letters should appear to melt and reform continuously, with individual characters stretching and compressing based on frequency data. The morphing should create organic, fluid transitions between words, as if the text is made of a viscous liquid. Higher frequencies cause ripple effects across the text surface, while bass frequencies create larger wave distortions. Include a subtle iridescent color effect that shifts based on the spectral centroid of the audio.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' containerProps. Each word gets its own BaseLayout with 'inline-flex'. Individual letters are TextAtom components with 'inline-block transition-all duration-300'. Apply SVG filters via containerProps.style for displacement effects. Create custom displacement maps using feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap. Use generic effects with AnimationRange for continuous morphing: scaleX (0.8 to 1.2), scaleY (1.2 to 0.8), skewX (-10 to 10deg). Layer waveform effects in 'translate' mode for Y-axis movement based on frequency bands. For the liquid effect, combine CSS properties: 'mix-blend-mode-overlay backdrop-blur-sm' with animated text-shadow for depth. Implement color shifts using CSS custom properties animated via generic effects, mapping spectral data to hue values. Use filter: blur() animations for motion blur during fast morphs. Set animation timings relative to parent with staggered delays for wave propagation effect. Consider using Lottie animations for complex liquid shapes if needed.

prompts.prompt: Build a crystallizing text animation where typography fragments into geometric shards that reconstruct themselves in sync with music. Picture a video editor shattering text layers into triangular pieces using a shatter effect, then reverse-engineering the explosion timed to audio beats. Each letter should break into 5-10 polygonal fragments that drift apart and reassemble. The crystallization process should feel like watching ice crystals form in reverse - sharp, angular movements with sudden snaps into place on beat drops. Add prismatic light refraction effects where each shard catches and splits light into rainbow spectrums based on its angle.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full preserve-3d' for 3D transforms. Each letter is a sub-preset containing multiple ShapeAtom components for polygon fragments. Use clip-path with polygon() to create triangular/crystalline shapes from text. Position fragments with 'absolute' and specific top/left values. Implement shattering via generic effects: translateX/Y with random offsets (-50 to 50px), rotate3d for tumbling motion, opacity fades. Use beat-synchronized waveform effects to trigger reassembly on impactful beats. For prismatic effects, layer multiple colored versions with 'mix-blend-mode-screen' and varying opacity. Apply CSS filters: 'drop-shadow() brightness() contrast()' for glass-like appearance. Use transform-style: preserve-3d with perspective for depth. Animate with spring easing for snappy crystallization. Consider using internal effect presets like 'shatter-in' and 'reassemble' for reusability. Set fitDurationTo based on caption timing to ensure complete cycles.

prompts.prompt: Create a recursive typography tunnel where text spirals infinitely inward while pulsing to the music rhythm. Think of it as a video editor duplicating text layers dozens of times, scaling and positioning them to create a tunnel effect, then animating the entire structure. Words should appear to travel from the viewer into an infinite vortex, with new text emerging from the edges and spiraling toward the center. The spiral rotation speed should match the BPM, while the tunnel depth pulses with bass hits. Apply a hypnotic color gradient that shifts through the spectrum as text moves deeper into the tunnel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center perspective-1000'. Use repeatChildrenProps to generate 20-30 text layers with decreasing scale (1.0 to 0.05). Each layer is a BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0' containing TextAtom components. Apply transforms: translateZ for depth positioning (0 to -1000px), scale for size reduction, rotateZ for spiral motion. Use generic effects for continuous rotation (0 to 360deg) with duration based on BPM. Layer waveform effects in 'scale' mode for bass-reactive pulsing. Implement color gradients using CSS linear-gradient backgrounds with animated background-position. Use opacity gradients (1.0 to 0.3) for depth fog effect. Apply blur filter to distant layers for depth of field. Consider using transform-origin manipulation for spiral path variations. Performance: use CSS containment, limit to 30 layers max, implement visibility culling for off-screen elements.

prompts.prompt: Develop a particle-based kinetic typography system where individual letters explode into pixel particles that swarm and reform based on audio dynamics. Imagine a video editor using particle systems where each letter becomes an emitter, releasing dozens of small text fragments that move in flocking patterns. The particles should exhibit swarm intelligence - clustering during quiet moments and dispersing explosively during drops. Each particle inherits a single character or pixel from the original text, maintaining readability while creating dynamic motion. Color temperature should shift from cool (calm) to warm (intense) based on audio energy levels.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Each letter spawns 10-20 particle sub-presets. Particles are small TextAtom or ShapeAtom components with 'absolute w-1 h-1' or 'w-2 h-2' sizing. Use JavaScript-calculated positions for flocking behavior in presetExecution. Implement particle physics: velocity, acceleration, and steering forces as transform animations. Use generic effects for base movement patterns (circular, linear, random walks). Layer waveform effects for explosion triggers on beat detection. Apply CSS transforms for particle motion: translate3d() for movement, scale() for size pulsing. Use opacity and blur for particle trails. Implement color temperature shifts via CSS filters: hue-rotate() and saturate() based on audio intensity. Consider using CSS custom properties for dynamic particle counts. Performance: use transform and opacity only, batch DOM updates, implement object pooling for particles.

prompts.prompt: Design a dimensional folding text effect where typography appears to fold through multiple spatial dimensions in response to music. Picture a video editor applying complex 3D folding animations to text layers, like origami transformations timed to audio cues. Text should fold in on itself, creating impossible geometries - letters turning inside out, words folding into tesseracts, sentences collapsing into higher dimensions. The folding complexity should increase with audio intensity, starting with simple 2D folds and progressing to mind-bending 4D rotations. Add dimensional rifts where text briefly disappears into fold creases with glitch effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' and CSS 3D transforms enabled via 'preserve-3d'. Split text into character segments using TextAtom with 'inline-block'. Apply complex transform chains: rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ combined with perspective shifts. Use transform-origin manipulation to create folding pivot points ('transform-origin-left', 'transform-origin-top-right'). Implement folding via generic effects with multiple keyframes for smooth origami-like motion. Add scaleZ and translateZ for depth illusion. For dimensional rifts, use clip-path animations with polygon() creating angular cuts. Apply glitch effects using CSS filters during fold transitions: 'filter: contrast(200%) brightness(150%)'. Use mix-blend-mode for dimensional overlap effects. Layer waveform effects to trigger fold complexity based on frequency analysis. Consider using sub-presets for reusable fold patterns. Performance: pre-calculate transform matrices, use CSS will-change, limit simultaneous folds.

prompts.prompt: Create a synaesthetic typography visualizer where text generates its own visual music through animated color frequencies and shape oscillations. Think of it as a video editor treating each letter as an audio visualizer bar that responds to its corresponding frequency in the sound spectrum. Vowels react to low frequencies with warm colors and smooth waves, consonants to high frequencies with cool colors and sharp peaks. Text should create visual harmonics - when certain letter combinations appear, they generate interference patterns and color mixing. The entire text composition becomes a living spectrogram.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-wrap items-end justify-center gap-2'. Each letter is a BaseLayout with 'relative inline-flex flex-col items-center'. Use TextAtom for the letter with dynamic height based on frequency data. Add ShapeAtom beneath each letter as a frequency bar with 'w-full bg-gradient-to-t' classes. Map letters to frequency ranges: vowels (20-250Hz), consonants (250-4000Hz). Use waveform effects in 'scale' mode with different frequency targets per letter type. Apply color via CSS custom properties animated through generic effects, mapping frequency to HSL values. Create interference patterns using CSS mix-blend-modes when letters overlap. Add glow effects using text-shadow and box-shadow animated to frequency amplitude. Implement visual harmonics with filter: blur() and opacity changes on letter combinations. Use fitDurationTo: 'audio' for perfect sync. Consider fetching audio analysis data for precise frequency mapping.

prompts.prompt: Build a quantum superposition typography effect where text exists in multiple probable states simultaneously, collapsing into definite forms on musical accents. Visualize this as a video editor layering multiple versions of the same text with different positions, rotations, and opacities, creating a quantum uncertainty effect. Text should flicker between possible arrangements - sometimes readable, sometimes abstract. On strong beats, all probabilities collapse into a single, clear state before dispersing again. Add particle-wave duality effects where text behaves as both solid letters and flowing waves.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full'. Create 5-8 probability layers using repeatChildrenProps, each with slight variations. Each layer is a BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 opacity-30'. Apply random transforms to each: translateX/Y (±20px), rotate (±15deg), scale (0.95-1.05). Use generic effects with rapid opacity fluctuations (0.1 to 0.6) to simulate quantum flickering. On beat detection via waveform effects, trigger 'collapse' animations: all layers converge to opacity:0 except one at opacity:1. For wave-particle duality, alternate between sharp text (particle) and blurred/distorted text (wave) using filter animations. Add chromatic aberration using text-shadow with offset RGB colors. Implement Heisenberg uncertainty with inverse relationship between position clarity and motion blur. Use CSS custom properties for probability weights. Performance: limit to 8 superposition states, use compositor-only properties.

prompts.prompt: Design a generative mandala typography system where text forms evolving sacred geometry patterns synchronized to music. Picture a video editor arranging text in circular patterns, then rotating multiple rings at different speeds like a complex watch mechanism. Each ring contains different text content - titles in the center, captions in middle rings, keywords in outer rings. The rings should rotate at rates derived from audio tempo divisions (1x, 0.5x, 2x BPM). Text size and spacing should breathe with the music, creating expanding and contracting mandala patterns. Add sacred geometry overlays with connecting lines between related words.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center'. Create concentric ring sub-presets with different radii. Each ring uses BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0' and custom CSS for circular text paths. Use SVG textPath for curved text or position individual TextAtoms with transform-rotate and translate. Calculate positions using trigonometry in presetExecution: x = radius * cos(angle), y = radius * sin(angle). Apply continuous rotation via generic effects with different durations per ring based on BPM divisions. Use waveform effects in 'scale' mode for breathing animations. Add ShapeAtom lines connecting keywords using absolute positioning and transform-origin manipulation. Implement color coding: warm colors for center (important), cool for outer rings. Use opacity gradients for depth. Apply filter: drop-shadow() for ethereal glow. Consider using CSS @property for smooth custom property animations. Performance: use transform-only animations, implement frustum culling for off-screen text.

prompts.prompt: Create an audio-reactive ASCII rain effect where typography cascades down like Matrix-style digital rain, but forms readable text patterns at beat intervals. Think of it as a video editor creating falling text columns that briefly align to spell out messages when the music hits key moments. Individual characters should fall at varying speeds based on their frequency assignment, with punctuation moving fastest and vowels slowest. The rain should part and converge to reveal hidden messages, creating a living, breathing wall of cascading typography. Add digital decay effects where older characters fragment into smaller symbols.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-black'. Create vertical columns using grid: 'grid grid-cols-20 gap-0'. Each column is a BaseLayout with 'relative h-full' containing falling TextAtom characters. Use generic effects for continuous translateY animation (-100% to 100vh) with varied durations (2-8s). Implement character spawning in presetExecution with random delays. On beat detection via waveform effects, trigger alignment animations where specific characters slow/stop to form words. Use opacity gradients: 'opacity-100' at top fading to 'opacity-20' at bottom. Apply text-shadow for glow: 'text-green-400 text-shadow-glow'. For digital decay, use filter effects and scale transforms on older characters. Implement character replacement logic for continuous variation. Add CSS custom properties for rain speed control based on audio tempo. Use monospace fonts for proper alignment: 'font-mono'. Performance: limit active columns, use CSS contain: layout, implement virtual scrolling for long sequences.
